title: Инверсия: Not until, Only then, Little; условные без if (Had I known…)

why: В прошлой теме мы вынесли вперёд never и rarely. Тот же приём работает с Not until, Only then, Little, а ещё позволяет убрать if из условных предложений. Результат: более формальная, «литературная» речь, которую часто встретишь в статьях, докладах и официальных письмах.
formation: Общая схема: вводное слово + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + основной глагол.
• Not until + время/клауза: Not until midnight did I finish. (Только к полуночи я закончил.)
• Only then / Only after / Only when + ...: Only then did she understand.
• Little + did + подлежащее + V1: Little did he know. (Он и не подозревал.)
• Had + подлежащее + V3 (вместо if + Past Perfect): Had I known, I would have called. = If I had known...
• Were + подлежащее (вместо if + were): Were I you, I'd wait. = If I were you...
• Should + подлежащее + V1 (вместо if + should / Present): Should you need help, call me.
Отрицание: Had they not left, ... (не Hadn't they).
usage: 1. Not until — «только когда / не раньше чем»: Not until I got home did I realize I'd lost my keys. (Только дома я понял, что потерял ключи.) Инверсия идёт во второй части, после запятой.
2. Only then / Only after / Only when — «только тогда / после / когда»: Only after the update did the bug disappear. (Только после обновления баг исчез.)
3. Little — «и не подозревал, и не думал»: Little did we know that the server would crash. (Мы и не знали, что сервер упадёт.) Little здесь значит «совсем не».

4. Условные без if — формально: Had I known about the delay, I would have told you. (Знай я о задержке, я бы вам сказал.) Should you have any questions, please contact us. (Если возникнут вопросы, свяжитесь с нами.)
signalWords: Not until, only then, only after, only when, only by, little (в начале предложения), had I / were I / should you в начале фразы без if.
mistakes: ✗ Not until he arrived the meeting started → ✓ Not until he arrived did the meeting start (инверсия во второй части)
✗ Little they knew → ✓ Little did they know
✗ Had I knew → ✓ Had I known (после had нужна третья форма)
✗ Hadn't I known → ✓ Had I not known (not ставим после подлежащего)
✗ Should you will need → ✓ Should you need (после should глагол в базовой форме)
remember: Начало предложения занято «особым» словом, тогда вспомогательный глагол идёт перед подлежащим: Not until I left DID I understand; HAD I known, I would have helped.

items.prompt: Not until midnight ___ I finish the report.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: Only then ___ she understand the problem.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: Little ___ he know that the server would crash.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: ___ I known about the delay, I would have called you.
items.answer: Had

items.prompt: ___ you need any help, please let me know.
items.answer: Should

items.prompt: ___ I you, I would accept the offer.
items.answer: Were

items.prompt: Not until she left ___ I realize how much I missed her.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: Only after the update ___ the bug disappear.
items.answer: did

items.prompt: (a) Not until he arrived did the meeting start. (b) Not until he arrived the meeting started.
items.answer: (a) Not until he arrived did the meeting start.

items.prompt: (a) Little they knew about the plan. (b) Little did they know about the plan.
items.answer: (b) Little did they know about the plan.

items.prompt: (a) Had I known, I would have helped. (b) Had I knew, I would have helped.
items.answer: (a) Had I known, I would have helped.

items.prompt: (a) Only then I understood. (b) Only then did I understand.
items.answer: (b) Only then did I understand.

items.prompt: (a) Should you have any questions, call me. (b) Should you will have any questions, call me.
items.answer: (a) Should you have any questions, call me.

items.prompt: (a) Were I you, I would wait. (b) Would I be you, I would wait.
items.answer: (a) Were I you, I would wait.

items.prompt: (a) Not until the code was tested did we release it. (b) Not until the code was tested we did release it.
items.answer: (a) Not until the code was tested did we release it.

items.prompt: (a) Only when the user logs in can they see the data. (b) Only when the user logs in they can see the data.
items.answer: (a) Only when the user logs in can they see the data.

items.prompt: If I had known, I would have told you.
items.answer: Had I known, I would have told you.

items.prompt: If you should need help, call me.
items.answer: Should you need help, call me.

items.prompt: If I were you, I would apply.
items.answer: Were I you, I would apply.

items.prompt: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
items.answer: Had she left earlier, she would have caught the train.

items.prompt: If you have any problems, contact support.
items.answer: Should you have any problems, contact support.

items.prompt: If we had saved the file, we wouldn't have lost the data.
items.answer: Had we saved the file, we wouldn't have lost the data.

items.prompt: If he were here, he would help us.
items.answer: Were he here, he would help us.

items.prompt: If they hadn't missed the flight, they would have arrived on time.
items.answer: Had they not missed the flight, they would have arrived on time.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав с данных слов

items.prompt: I didn't realize my mistake until I read the email. → Not until ...
items.answer: Not until I read the email did I realize my mistake.

items.prompt: He didn't know that he would win. → Little ...
items.answer: Little did he know that he would win.

items.prompt: She only understood the problem then. → Only then ...
items.answer: Only then did she understand the problem.

items.prompt: We didn't leave until the rain stopped. → Not until ...
items.answer: Not until the rain stopped did we leave.

items.prompt: They only found the bug after three days. → Only after ...
items.answer: Only after three days did they find the bug.

items.prompt: I never suspected that the project would fail. → Little ...
items.answer: Little did I suspect that the project would fail.

items.prompt: He started to feel better only when he went outside. → Only when ...
items.answer: Only when he went outside did he start to feel better.

items.prompt: The system didn't work again until we restarted it. → Not until ...
items.answer: Not until we restarted it did the system work again.

items.prompt: Только тогда я понял, как всё серьёзно.
items.answer: Only then did I realize how serious it was. / Only then did I understand how serious it was.

items.prompt: Они и не подозревали, что их ждёт.
items.answer: Little did they know what was waiting for them. / Little did they know what awaited them.

items.prompt: Только когда я вернулся домой, я заметил, что потерял ключи.
items.answer: Only when I got home did I notice that I had lost my keys. / Only when I got home did I notice that I'd lost my keys.

items.prompt: Знай я об этом раньше, я бы вам позвонил.
items.answer: Had I known about it earlier, I would have called you.

items.prompt: Если вам понадобится помощь, обращайтесь.
items.answer: Should you need any help, please let us know. / Should you need help, please contact us.

items.prompt: Будь я на вашем месте, я бы согласился.
items.answer: Were I in your position, I would agree. / Were I you, I would agree.

items.prompt: Мы поняли, что это ошибка, только когда прочитали отчёт.
items.answer: Not until we read the report did we understand that it was a mistake. / Not until we read the report did we realize it was a mistake.

items.prompt: Приложение запустилось только после того, как разработчик исправил ошибку.
items.answer: Only after the developer fixed the error did the app start. / Not until the developer fixed the error did the app start.
